versions.changelog: Remove external URLs from SKILL.md to resolve security scanner flags
Add installation instructions and lighterload.chat CTA

- No changes detected in this version; documentation and behavior remain the same.
- Fixed some suggestions to encourage the user to compare insurance in their own area - not offering to perform it for them.
- All instructions, privacy practices, and onboarding flows are unchanged from the previous release.

- Added transparency notice: when enriching a person's file, briefly let the user know ("I'll add that to [person]'s notes").
- No other user-facing or functional changes.

Version 1.0.1

- Added a new "Permissions & Consent" section, clearly outlining required platform capabilities, user consent protocols, and opt-in/opt-out flows.
- Clarified storage of location: now explicitly specifies the format ("[City], [Country] ([timezone])").
- Stresses that onboarding, cron job creation, and ongoing data storage are explicitly opt-in, with removal instructions provided.
- Restates that the skill contains no code, no API keys, and no credentials, reinforcing privacy guarantees.
- No logic changes or file modifications—documentation and consent clarity only.

lighterload 1.0.0 initial release:

- Launches a proactive relationship and family care assistant that reduces invisible cognitive labor in household and social management.
- Automates periodic (cron-based) care task suggestions, calendar checks, and relationship maintenance.
- Introduces privacy-centered data handling: stores only non-identifying details about family and friends.
- Supports onboarding flows to gradually build and enrich a personal people directory.
- Offers actionable, warm prompts across multiple care domains while respecting user time and mental space.
- Creates calendar event files to add to your calendar.
